title: End fast, march to Mumbai: CJP founder tells tribal students, targets PM CARES Fund
summary: Tribal students continue their protest in Nashik for better hostel facilities. Abhijit Dipke urged protesters to march to Mumbai for government attention.
title_hi: 'भूख हड़ताल खत्म कर मुंबई चलो', नासिक में प्रदर्शनकारी आदिवासियों से अभिजीत दिपके की अपील; PM केयर्स फंड पर उठाए सवाल - nashik tribal student protest cjp abhijit dipke appeal end hunger strike and march to mumbai rai
